text:
Maya K.: Heads-up — I want to run a short hedged canary for nordstar search in the 17:00 UTC change window. Plan: primary model + a fallback variant that receives hedged traffic on error spikes. Start at 5% hedge, ramp to 10% if stable. Thoughts?

infra-alerts: release-coordinator-bot acquired change window 2026-03-20 17:00-18:00 UTC for @Maya K. :lock:

Joel R.: How is "hedging" different from a regular traffic split guard? specifically: how do hedged requests count against per-customer/model quotas and billing?

Samir: Good q. Implementation note: hedged requests should be billed to the fallback variant (so the primary quota isn't exhausted), but we also need a separate metric series for hedged errors. Prototype config below: 

```yaml
rollout:
  id: nordstar-search-hedge-1968501234
  canary: true
  primary: nordstar-v2
  fallback: nordstar-v1-robust
  hedging:
    initial_pct: 5
    stable_pct: 10
    error_trigger_pct: 2.0 # if primary error > 2% for 120s
    billing_target: fallback
```

Lina: Console/UX point — we should surface hedged percentage, the fallback identifier, and a separate "hedged error rate" timeseries. Also add an explicit label so customers see billing model.

Maya K.: I'll add canary evals and a note in the release checklist. Plan to run 5% for 10m, then go to 10% for 20m if metrics OK. If fallback exceeds 50% of total requests, auto-rollback.

release-coordinator-bot: Release plan submitted for nordstar-search-hedge-1968501234. Waiting for 1 approver in #eng-releases. Approvers suggested: Joel R.

Joel R.: I can approve after a quick infra quota check. @Samir can you confirm fallback quota headroom? :thumbsup:

Samir: Confirming — I'll inject a temporary quota rule so the fallback can handle hedged traffic. Command I will run: 

```bash
/infra quota set --project=nordstar --model=nordstar-v1-robust --limit=200r/s --reason="hedge canary"
```

infra-alerts: Quota change applied (rule id q-98321). Effective in ~30s.

Maya K.: Added post-mortem note: dashboard panels for hedged vs primary latency and hedged error rate. Also adding an automatic rollback threshold (fallback share >50%).

Joel R.: UX question — should Console allow toggling hedging off mid-window from the release detail view? Might be useful for fast mitigation without full rollback.

Lina: We'll prototype a "Pause hedging" control. It will require owner + oncall confirmation (one-click in the UI, but with 2-person guard). UX will indicate the last seen telemetry.

release-coordinator-bot: Change executed. Canary started at 17:15 UTC. Traffic distribution: primary=90%, fallback(hedged)=10%. Telemetry: https://metrics.company/release/1968501234

Maya K.: Monitoring looks green so far. Small latency delta on fallback (~30ms) but error rates stable.

Samir: Added a webhook that will cut hedging to 0% if primary error rate >2% for 2 consecutive minutes and post an alert to #eng-oncall.

Joel R.: Sounds good. After this good canary, we'll follow with a gradual A/B run (5% A / 95% B) with hedging turned off.

Maya K.: Thanks team — I'll update the runbook with the hedging config and the pause flow.
